message.reasoning_content:
need to determine appropriate criminal charges based on facts. The case: three defendants (朱某, 许2某, 曲某) premeditated, used false investment scheme (Harvard financial project) to attract victims, get money, some returned as partial refunds, total 40+万元, used for personal consumption. This is classic fraud (诈骗罪). Also possibly "非法集资"? But the description: virtual Harvard investment, development of downline, pyramid scheme. Could be "非法集资" (illegal fundraising) or "组织、领导传销活动"? However they are not necessarily a pyramid scheme? They develop downline investors, get more profit as more people join. That resembles pyramid scheme (传销). But the charge in Chinese law: "组织、领导传销活动罪" (criminal law article 224). However the facts mention they used false investment to get money, not necessarily a pyramid scheme but a Ponzi scheme. The typical charge is "诈骗罪". Also maybe "非法吸收公众存款罪"? But they targeted individuals, not public. The amount is 40+万元, which is "数额巨大" qualifies for fraud.

Thus likely only one charge: 诈骗.

Check if any other charges: "非法占有为目的" indicates fraud. No mention of "非法集资" or "组织、领导传销". So answer: [罪名]诈骗<eoa>.
